_readme: Native app update check (backend/src/app_version.js). To FORCE an update, set min.ios / min.android to the oldest version still allowed (e.g. "1.12.9") and commit; apps below it show a blocking Update screen within ~10 min. Leave "" for no minimum. android.latest is written by release-android.yml; iOS latest comes from the App Store itself. message (optional) is shown on the required-update screen.
